description: An organizational consulting firm has developed a 360-degree leadership competency assessment survey in LimeSurvey that is currently open to anyone who has the link. Your task as the I-O psychologist managing this engagement is to convert the survey titled 'Leadership Competency Assessment 360' (already created in the system) to a closed-access survey that only invited participants can complete using unique tokens. Log in at http://localhost/index.php/admin with admin/Admin123!. Enable participant token management on this survey. Add the following four raters to the participant list: Marcus Thompson (m.thompson@acmecorp.com), Sarah Chen (s.chen@acmecorp.com), David Okafor (d.okafor@acmecorp.com), and Priya Sharma (p.sharma@acmecorp.com). Customize the survey's invitation email so the subject line reads exactly: 'Your 360-Degree Leadership Feedback Request - Action Required'. Generate unique access tokens for all participants so they are ready to receive invitations.

metadata.instrument_source: Adapted from Korn Ferry Lominger Leadership Architect competency framework
